name: ♡beAt！
source:
A small entertainment agency in Tokyo, Yotsuba Productions, 428 Pro for short. It is a place where various idols play an active part and shine. Mainly on the idol unit ❤beAt (heartbeat), the name of 428 has been spread in various places since its debut.

Among them, the most shining top idol is Hajime Koa. However, there is a secret that no one knows about leaf scar romance, and the hero who knows it is spending slapstick days running around the office and school today to keep the secret of romance. rice field.

One day, a new idol who entered the office became a member of ❤beAt, but something started to move behind the scenes ...

[Translated from [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/heartbeat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
东京有一家规模不大的演艺经纪公司，名叫四叶草经纪公司，简称428公司。这里是各式偶像活跃、闪耀的舞台。以偶像组合♡beAt为核心，从她们出道起，428的名号便逐渐传遍各地。

其中，最耀眼的顶级偶像便是叶痕恋爱。然而，她藏着一个无人知晓的秘密。知道真相的主角为了守住她的秘密，今天也在公司与学校之间奔波，过着鸡飞狗跳的日子。

某天，公司新来的偶像加入了♡beAt，而以此为契机，某些事情开始在暗中悄然发生…

[译自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/heartbeat]itch.io[/url]]
